name: Class timetable
summary: Keeps the class timetable in the business's booking system. Crons read the next weeks of classes and seats, flag classes that are under-filled, and queue any class cancellation or room block the owner or agent has proposed. A person approves every change that reaches a member.

covered_by.class-setup: gap (Bookeo products are set up in the platform; no mapped create-class operation)
covered_by.instructor-roster: gap (no mapped instructor assignment in Bookeo)
covered_by.publish-timetable: gap (public timetable is set in the platform)
covered_by.change-or-cancel: change-queue (cancellations and room blocks, approval only)
covered_by.member-notify: change-queue (Bookeo notifies the customer on a cancellation, through the approved operation)

crons.name: snapshot
crons.summary: Hourly: read the next weeks of classes, their seats and room blocks into the store. Reads only.

crons.name: fill-review
crons.summary: Daily: flag classes under the fill target into the store for the owner's weekly review. Writes to the store only.

crons.name: change-queue
crons.summary: Turns proposed class cancellations and room blocks into approvals. Queues only; a person approves each one.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads only. Cancelling a booking (which notifies the customer) and blocking a room change what members see or book, so they are live operations and wait for a person.

bookeo.covers: product list, seats per class, bookings, room blocks, booking cancellation with customer notice

gaps: Platforms in the mining evidence (Gymdesk, GymMaster, Mindbody) are not in this kit, so none of them has an adapter. Gymdesk and GymMaster publish timetables and bookings; Mindbody sells the same through ClassPass. Each needs an OpenAPI spec and an adapter before it can run here.
Confirm the workflow steps and platform coverage with the business before enabling its crons.
Creating or editing a class, assigning or swapping instructors, and moving a class to a new time have no mapped Bookeo operation. They stay manual in the platform.
Check-in and attendance records have no mapped Bookeo operation.
Bookeo capacity is not a single field here. Fill rate is seats left plus non-cancelled bookings for the same event, which is an approximation until a live account confirms it.

The Bookeo adapter follows pageNavigationToken for each list, up to 5,000 rows, and stops loudly past that. Paging is tested on a fake network only, so the info token shape is unverified on a live account.
Member notices for a moved or changed class (not a cancellation) have no mapped operation. The Bookeo cancellation notice goes out through notifyCustomer.
Every adapter stays docs-only until a Bookeo sandbox account proves it.
